Subject: Procurement readiness & MPA — recap from today's call

Hi Sam / Priya —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum on the procurement path: 

Summary of what we heard: 
- Legal wants a short SOW + standard T&Cs reviewed (timeline: ~2 weeks)
- Security needs the SOC2 report and an architecture diagram (they indicated 3-5 business days once docs received)
- Finance prefers to use PO for initial committed capacity; credit card for short-term POC is acceptable for < $10k
- Marketplace is of interest (AWS Marketplace) but will likely be a longer initiative separate from the initial purchase

Proposed next steps (please confirm):
1) I will share a draft SOW and the MPA spreadsheet to align milestone owners and dates (attached).
2) You share the preferred commercial path (PO vs card) and timing for PO issuance.
3) Your security contact sends any specific evidence intake instructions or a list of required docs.
4) Redwood to provide SOC2 report, architecture diagram, and SOW draft by EOD Monday.

Proposed timeline (high level):
- Week 0 (this week): Redwood sends SOW draft + SOC2 + diagram; AcmeCloud confirms commercial path
- Week 1: Legal review & security intake; finance submits PO (if PO route)
- Week 2: Final SOW sign-off; PO issuance and provisioning

Attachments: AcmeCloud_MPA_v2.xlsx (MPA draft for you to edit)

If that looks right, can you confirm: (A) who on your side will own legal/security/finance signoffs, and (B) whether PO is the expected path and approximate PO date?

Thanks,
Marissa
